newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Korea Tech, six S.Korean IPOs to trade Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Korea Tech, six S.Korean IPOs to trade Tuesday.

text.p: Korea Technology Banking Corp's initial public offering (IPO) will begin trading on Tuesday, along with six other offerings, the Korea Stock Exchange said on Monday.
Korea Technology Banking Corp, an investment and short-term finance company, will list six million new shares.
The shares had a subscription price of 9,000 won per share.
The following shares will join Korea Technology on Tuesday:
Dongyang Mutual Savings and Finance Co Ltd will list 940,000 shares. The IPO subscription price was set at 6,300 won per share.
Daeyang Mutual Savings and Finance Co Ltd will list 783,800 shares with a subscription price of 14,000 won each.
Dong-A Mutual Savings and Finance Co Ltd will list 720,000 shares. The subscription price was 8,000 won per share.
Seoul Mutual Savings and Finance Co Ltd 87550.KS, listing 640,000 shares and the IPO supscription price was set at 7,500 won per share.
Hanmi Leasing Co Ltd 87820.KS, a short-term finance firm, will list 3.44 million shares which had a subscription price of 6,500 won each.
Hanil Leasing Co Ltd 87810.KS, a short-term finance firm, listing 4.3 million shares with a subscription price of 7,500 won a share.
